items.title: ICE said a man jumped on the hood of their vehicle. Video — and police — say otherwise
items.brief: When footage of a man being hit by federal immigration officers’ SUV in Northern California became public, the Department of Homeland Security responded by saying the man had jumped on the vehicle’s hood.

items.title: 11-year-old, other minors among 11 shot near Florida university stadium
items.brief: A shooting near a college stadium in Tallahassee, Florida, left 11 with gunshot wounds Saturday night, officials said.

items.title: Musk accuses Ukraine of violating Starlink’s terms of service following dispute over coverage
items.brief: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has accused Ukraine’s military of violating Starlink’s terms of service, after Kyiv said that access to the service had been restored.

items.title: Rent control doomed this mayor’s re-election campaign. He has no regrets
items.brief: Brett Smiley was elected mayor of Providence in 2022 on a pledge to build more housing and get things done in Rhode Island’s capital city.

items.title: ‘A Few Good Men’ is back for the Trump era. Did Aaron Sorkin help get us here?
items.brief: The arc of Bradley Whitford’s career makes for a grim report card on the state of the country.

items.title: Once high-powered and influential brothers set to be sentenced for sex trafficking
items.brief: Three brothers who once lived at the height of wealth and society in New York and Miami could face life in prison for sex trafficking more than a dozen women and girls when they are sentenced Tuesday in federal court…

items.title: France sees another weekend of mass protests as thousands rally across Europe
items.brief: Nearly 1,000 people were detained across France Saturday as a wave of largely-peaceful protests airing economic grievances returned to the streets of its major cities, mirroring similar demonstrations across Europe.

items.title: Iowa’s cancer problem is scrambling the midterms
items.brief: As the debate season kicked off in Iowa’s heated gubernatorial race, one question seemed to animate and, in some ways, unify the candidates.
